author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಕಾಣದಿಹ ದೇವನನು ಎಲ್ಲೆಲ್ಲಿ ಹುಡುಕುವೆಯೊ
ದೋಣಿಯಂತಿಹ ಬದುಕಿಗವನೆ ನಾವಿಕನು
ಪ್ರಾಣದೀವಿಗೆಯಾಗಿ ನಿನ್ನೊಳಗೆ ಅವನಿರುವ
ತ್ರಾಣನಿನಗಾಗಿರುವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: Where all do you search for the God you cannot see?
For life, which is like a boat, he alone is the boatman;
as the lamp of life he dwells within you,
he is there as your strength, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: We look everywhere for a God we cannot see, yet he steers the boat of our life. He lives within us as the flame of life itself, and he is our strength.
